borderlessInfo: Borderless uses the selected desktop resolution and keeps your monitor arrangement.
rendererInfo: Modern graphics includes the tested water correction and a 60 FPS limit. Availability is checked on this PC.
maximumFx: ReShade Maximum: cinematic light and more depth
maximumFxInfo: Adds indirect light and color bounce (screen-space GI), spatial occlusion, SMAA and bloom. With Midsummer selected in-game: morning haze clears before daytime heat shimmer appears over warm surfaces. A stronger cinematic look. Requires Modern graphics and more GPU work. Ultra shadows remain separate.
qualityRecommendedInfo: WePlay recommended selects Modern graphics, high detail with longer visibility, 4096 shadows and SMAA as the only ReShade effect. Extra color and contact shading effects and Ultra shadows stay off. Also select Midsummer under Environment in the game. Save applies these choices on the next launch.
qualityPresetInfo: Presets set the controls below: high texture, lighting, shadow and water quality without depth of field, with game antialiasing and 16× texture filtering. Clear landscape keeps object detail at Medium; Highest object detail also raises it to High. Click Save to apply. Higher load and memory use are possible; check on this PC.
anisotropicFiltering: Sharper landscape textures (16× anisotropic filtering, Modern graphics only)
extendedDetail: Keep high detail longer when zooming out
extendedDetailInfo: Extends model detail distances and distance-based visibility limits by 50%, including settlers and trees. Texture mip selection stays unchanged. May increase GPU load. Takes effect on the next game launch.
detailedShadowsInfo: Doubles the shadow map's edge length (4096 × 4096 at the highest shadow quality). Uses more graphics memory and processing power. Does not automatically extend shadow range. Takes effect on the next game launch.
extendedShadowRangeInfo: Extends the detailed shadow cascades and far range by 50%. Enable longer detail retention too for detailed distant trees. Spreads the available shadow resolution over a larger area; higher shadow resolution is a separate option. Takes effect on the next game launch.
midsummerTone: Gentle colors and highlights (ReShade, Modern graphics only)
enhancedAa: SMAA edge smoothing (ReShade, Modern graphics only)
enhancedAaInfo: Spatial SMAA edge smoothing. Works independently of all other ReShade effects. With the other effects off, loads only SMAA, without GI, color grading, haze, heat shimmer or contact shading. Processes the full image, including the HUD. Applies on the next game launch.
contactShadows: Fine contact shading (ReShade, Modern graphics only)
contactShadowsInfo: Restrained contact shading from visible depth geometry. First enablement downloads about 4 MB for the official ReShade add-on runtime. Only this effect automatically does nothing when depth is unavailable. Applies on the next game launch.
ultraShadows: Ultra shadows with more near detail (8192 at high quality)
ultraShadowsInfo: Overrides the ordinary higher shadow resolution with 8192 and concentrates cascade detail nearer the camera. Uses more graphics memory and GPU time. Shadow range remains separate. Applies on the next game launch.
midsummerToneInfo: First save downloads about 4 MB from reshade.me. Restrained color grading and softer highlights, without extra depth of field. Select the bright lighting cycle in game under Options → Gameplay → Environment → Mittsommer / Midsummer. Takes effect on the next game launch.
anisotropicInfo: Improves textures viewed at an angle. Adds no lighting or geometry. Turn off if artifacts appear; has no effect in compatible mode. The 60 FPS cap and water correction remain active.
simple: Simple main menu + VSync (lower CPU use)

startGuideTitle: Which start method should I use?
startGuide:
Solo: campaign, AI games or the map editor on this PC.
LAN: everyone on the same home network starts LAN mode.
Private Internet: one player creates a room; friends join with its invitation.
Public Internet: find open matches in the shared game list or offer your own. Discord is optional and adds a listing in the community channel.
roomGuide: Room and match are two steps: the WePlay room connects your PCs. One player then creates the match under Multiplayer in S7 with “Private session” off; the others select it there. That setting alone publishes nothing on Discord.
invitationGuide: Keep these separate: the Discord server link opens the community. The Discord connection code only enables automatic match listings. The WePlay room invitation comes from the creator and connects you to their group.
graphicsModeInfo: Automatic chooses modern graphics when your PC supports it. Compatible graphics is the fallback for graphics problems. Save applies your choice to the next game start.
maintenanceGuide: Check looks for damaged or missing game files. Repair opens setup for the separate game copy. Compatible graphics saves the fallback mode; checking graphics support tests this PC again. Removing older versions frees disk space and asks first. A diagnostic report helps investigate problems.
managedFound: Your WePlay copy is ready for repair or updating. The original game folder is not needed.

internetNetworkSummary: EasyTier sets up an encrypted virtual network for your private match. Before each new connection, you receive an explanation and choose explicitly whether to allow it.
internetConsentPublic: Public lobby: You are connecting to the PCs in a publicly offered game. When hosting, your public match appears in the WePlay directory and, where configured, on the Discord board.
internetConsentPrivate: Private room: You are connecting to the invited players’ PCs. This path does not list the match publicly. Share the invitation code only with the intended participants.
internetConsentDetails:
EasyTier runs as a bundled network process for this connection and temporarily creates a virtual network adapter. No EasyTier account is needed. Closing the room closes its managed connection.

Automatic mode uses public rendezvous nodes and relays when needed. Game traffic is encrypted; direct peers and rendezvous services can learn connection addresses.

WePlay restricts the tunnel to game and lobby traffic. Other services and forwarding into the home network are blocked. This does not eliminate vulnerabilities in S7, EasyTier or Windows, overload attempts or disconnections. These residual risks remain; freedom from harm is not guaranteed.

Consent applies to this new connection. Opening or refreshing the directory alone does not connect your PC to other players.
